pokedexEntries.sw: After absorbing plenty of sunlight, Cherrim takes this form. It’s full of energy while it’s like this, and its liveliness will go on until sundown.

pokedexEntries.sh: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

pokedexEntries.la: Cheerfully active on sunny days. Immediately closes its petals and becomes immobile once the sun becomes hidden, however.
